mode: verbatim ingest, embedding backend (hf.co/CompendiumLabs/bge-base-zh-v1.5-gguf:Q8_0 via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, brute-force cosine), default recall stages (broad profile), no LLM
how: config.build_gateway(dict); EmbeddingBackend.put_many([(text, id, date)]) once for all memories; Gateway.recall('owner', {'query': q}) for deployed; EmbeddingBackend.find(query, 10) for ranked
notes: Backend is the embedding backend: model hf.co/CompendiumLabs/bge-base-zh-v1.5-gguf:Q8_0, cosine mapped to 0..1 with floor 0.35 and ceil 0.80 (the backend's values for this model, chosen on the development sets, not on this data); query prefix set, document prefix none.
ranked scores are the mapped relevance values, not comparable across systems.

deployed uses the default recall stages, whose default profile is broad (min_score with the backend's broad line 0.05, relative_score with its ratio 0.50, fill_text, drop_oversize, redact, dedupe, budget) and the default limit of 5; no profile is passed; ms times that Gateway.recall call only. The broad lines were chosen on the development set by the broad rule of bench/dev_eval.py (precision >= 50 % and at least half of the precise quiet rate, best delivered hit); the precise lines are 0.25 and 0.75 (the -precise run).
Deployed items are reported by the id field of each recall item; 0 item(s) named no dataset memory.
0 recall call(s) did not answer 200; 0 ranked search(es) failed.
deployed was timed before ranked, so ms includes the real query embedding request; ranked then reuses the backend's query-embedding cache.
Gateway.recall was called directly, so the per-client rate limiter (applied only in admit) was not involved.
Memories were ingested with one put_many call (embedding requests of 32 texts); ingest_seconds covers it.
